messages:
Sam: FYI prod p99 token latency jumped ~2x after driver 555.12 rolled overnight. Autotuner is picking short-seq vectorized kernel now. Seeing KV cache miss spike too.
Anya: :eyes: which clusters/regions?
Sam: us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Affected routes: /generate-chat (seq<=64 path). Metrics: p99 320ms -> 680ms, kv_cache_hitrate 78% -> 52%, kernel_hit_rate(shortseq_vectorized)=0.87 -> 0.98
Devin: that's consistent with a kernel-choice that bypasses our prefix-KV fastpath. Can you paste a kernel decision trace?
Sam: ```json
{"model":"r-infer-v2","seq":48,"chosen_kernel":"vec_attn_shortseq","candidate_scores":{"vec_attn_shortseq":0.87,"baseline_attn":0.13}}
```
Anya: OpsBot reported driver-upgrade deploy at 03:14 UTC.
OpsBot: deploy: driver-upgrade/555.12 applied to pool-gpu-uswest2 at 2024-11-02T03:14Z
Maria: Temporary mitigations: 1) flip autotuner bias to prefer baseline_attn for seq<=128, 2) force older driver on small canary nodes, 3) rollback driver cluster-wide. Prefer 1 or 2 first.
Kevin: Agree. 3 is heavy. 1 is quick if we can hotpatch the selector. Who owns the selector flag?
Devin: I can push a selector flag. Patch: `selector.override.shortseq=baseline_attn` — will roll to canary nodes via ops API.
Sam: If we do that, need to check kv_cache warmup for the canary—prefill TTL maybe.
Anya: Proposed canary plan: 5% traffic, 4h observation, verify p99 within 1.1x baseline and kv_hit back to >=75%. If ok, 50% ramp, then full.
Devin: Deploying flag to canary now.
OpsBot: flag_toggle: selector.override.shortseq=baseline_attn -> enabled on canary-gpu-1
Maria: Monitoring view: https://dash.internal/r-infer/p99?range=1h (link)
Kevin: Early signs: p99 on canary back to 300ms, kv_hitrate 76%. Good.
Anya: Let's keep canary for 2h then ramp to 50%. If we see regressions, rollback flag and schedule driver rollback.
Sam: Noted. I'll open a postmortem stub and collect traces.
Devin: Patch to autotuner queued: prefer baseline when kv_cache_miss_rate > 15% for seq<=128 (longer-term fix).
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll ping enterprise support about a coordinated driver rollback window if needed.
Anya: Thanks team, update here with the 2h check.
